key_concepts: Different types of power plants generate electrical energy
Hydroelectric, geothermal, wind, coal, and nuclear power plants use different energy sourc
Electrical energy is transmitted and distributed from power plants to households
Transformers induce voltage through electromagnetic induction
Step-up transformers increase voltage while step-down transformers decrease voltage
The number of loops in a transformer coil affects the amount of induced voltage
Electrical hazards can occur at home and in the environment
Safety precautions help prevent electrical hazards when handling electrical devices
